legend-high-road-to-taos.slogan: High Road to Taos – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-high-road-to-taos.story: National Scenic Byway. pueblos, mountains, historic churches. From Santa Fe it runs 93 km to Taos; allow about 1 h 41 of riding. The stops in between: Chimayo, High Road to Taos and Ranchos de Taos. The highest point is about 2,800 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: High Road to Taos
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 13 km this is High Road to Taos, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
